note: Explicit, OWNER-APPROVED OCR/import station-text corrections. NON-MUTATING: the original .xlsx is never altered; each correction is applied to a derived copy under _corrected_logs/ and fed to the engine through the normal file-fed path. NEVER auto-generated, NEVER a guessed value, NEVER a blanket digit replacement. Each entry is per-log, per-cell, owner-approved, and MUST carry reviewer (approved_by), reason, reviewed_at (timestamp) + evidence. A station_map key that does not match the current extracted value is REFUSED (correction_lib strict=True), so a stale/typo'd correction can never silently proceed. Adding a log here + rerunning build_coverage.py (or apply_and_rerun.py) is the only way a correction takes effect.
